Incumbent [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]] [[Richard Bryan]] won re-election to a second term. This was the last time a Democrat won Nevada's Class 1 Senate Seat until [[Jacky Rosen]] was elected to it in [[2018 United States Senate election in Nevada|2018]]. == Democratic primary == === Candidates === * [[Richard Bryan]], incumbent U.S. Senator === Results === Bryan was unopposed in the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] primary. == Republican primary == === Candidates === * [[Hal Furman]], former Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Interior for Water and Science and former legislative counsel to U.S. Senator [[Paul Laxalt]]{{Cite web|url=http://www.ourcampaigns.com/CandidateDetail.html?CandidateID=13209|title=Our Campaigns - Candidate - Harold W.
